notes: REACHES GAMEPLAY 2026-08-31 (this recipe supersedes the 08-30 'UNBLOCKED' one; do not restore that from a handoff). Three TOKAEMM gaps blocked this title in sequence, each found by INT-tracing (IZARRAVM_INT_TRACE on an int-trace build) against JEMMEX-under-IzarraVM and DOSBox-X references: (1) fn 53h set-handle-name answered 84h and the loader read that as 'no expanded memory' (PR #777); (2) fn 5901h answered 84h leaving stale BX, so the streaming pool was sized from garbage (PR #780); (3) ef_map_multi (fn 5000h) validated all pairs atomically and applied NONE on error, where EMM386/DOSBox apply pairs sequentially and stop at the first bad one -- the game maps 4-page batches past its asset's last logical page, ignores the 8Ah, and decodes from the pages that DID land, so the atomic reject left the EMS frame stale and livelocked the post-baron-select load forever (PR #780, merged 90bbb304). Memory, video, keyboard, and sound were all exonerated along the way; the game needs 580K free (startup check) and ~585K suffices in practice. Schedule: menu settles ~22s guest; home+move puts the cursor on Westinghouse (242,105 game px); 'n' (27s) opens the Baron Gallery; a REAL mouse click (30s) on the portrait opens the name box (menu buttons ignore clicks; the gallery accepts them); Enter (33s) accepts the default name and the game loads into the Initial Purchase of Private Companies screen (~40s); a click on the top-left company card (45-47.5s: home + move to 66,13 game px + click) starts the bidding and the AI buys through four companies by 58s. Mouse math: 2 mickeys per game pixel on both axes from a home (0,0) origin; game runs 320x200 mode X double-scanned (presented 320x400, presented y = 2x game y). Copy protection (manual word lookup, ENTER bypasses per ReadMe.txt) comes after the first stock round -- beyond this fixture's window.
